findings.text: follow-on: _composite duplicates the risk-order driver's _item_risk at ssog-risk-order-run.py:108 rather than extending or wrapping its owner, so a future change to the hand-set risk rule can make the two arms silently diverge.

follow-on: split membership is taken from the risk-results row while the fragment says it comes from the golden fixture; no comparison to the fixture guards the calibration/validation assignment against source drift.

follow-on: verdict_matches_interval compares two fields produced from the same paired result, so changing the paired lower bound and adopted flag together leaves this assertion true; verify also does not independently replay the published AUCs or fitted weights.

follow-on: the caption says the learned ROC curve stays above the composite from about false-positive rate 0.10 onward and then says the composite crosses above it below 0.2; the rendered curves confirm the latter, so the first claim misstates that range.
